title: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026 (published April 24) disclosing the reclassification of director Steven D. Harr, M.D. from Class I to Class III to balance the three board classes per the company's certificate of incorporation. Dr. Harr's service was uninterrupted. This is a routine corporate governance matter with no market structure or macro relevance.
key_points: Registrant: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. (ticker: SANA; exchange: Nasdaq)
Date of event: April 22, 2026; filing date: April 24, 2026
Action: Director Steven D. Harr, M.D. resigned as Class I director and was immediately re-appointed as Class III director
Purpose: To achieve equal balance among the three board classes (I, II, III) as required by the Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation
Board composition: Three directors in each of Class I, II, and III following the reclassification
Dr. Harr's service deemed uninterrupted; no change in overall board tenure
